name: Steal A Brainrot Egg
desc:
Welcome to Steal A Brainrot Egg 🥚 

How to play:
Steal eggs from brainrots 🥚
Hatch eggs to collect rare brainrots 🐣
Earn money from your brainrots 💰
Upgrade your treadmill and base ⬆️
Train on the treadmill to gain speed  🏃
Steal eggs from other players 🥚 
Discover rarer eggs, brainrots, sizes, and mutations!
